1.web: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
1.asv: Therefore let us also, seeing we are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

2.web: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
2.asv: looking unto Jesus the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising shame, and hath sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

3.web: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
3.asv: For consider him that hath endured such gainsaying of sinners against himself, that ye wax not weary, fainting in your souls.

4.web: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin;
4.asv: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin:

5.web: and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;
5.asv: and ye have forgotten the exhortation which reasoneth with you as with sons, My son, regard not lightly the chastening of the Lord, Nor faint when thou art reproved of him;

6.web: For whom the Lord loves, he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.”
6.asv: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth, And scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.

7.web: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
7.asv: It is for chastening that ye endure; God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is there whom his father chasteneth not?

8.web: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then are you illegitimate, and not children.
8.asv: But if ye are without chastening, whereof all have been made partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

9.web: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?
9.asv: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

10.web: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
10.asv: For they indeed for a few days chastened us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

11.web: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.
11.asv: All chastening seemeth for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yieldeth peaceable fruit unto them that have been exercised thereby, even the fruit of righteousness.

12.web: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
12.asv: Wherefore lift up the hands that hang down, and the palsied knees;

13.web: and make straight paths for your feet, so that which is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
13.asv: and make straight paths for your feet, that that which is lame be not turned out of the way, but rather be healed.

14.web: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
14.asv: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man shall see the Lord:

15.web: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it;
15.asv: looking carefully lestthere beany man that falleth short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby the many be defiled;

16.web: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
16.asv: lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one mess of meat sold his own birthright.

17.web: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
17.asv: For ye know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected; for he found no place for a change of mind in his father, though he sought it diligently with tears.

18.web: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
18.asv: For ye are not come unto a mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

19.web: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
19.asv: and the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard entreated that no word more should be spoken unto them;

20.web: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”;
20.asv: for they could not endure that which was enjoined, If even a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned;

21.web: and so fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
21.asv: and so fearful was the appearance, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:

22.web: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
22.asv: but ye are come unto mount Zion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable hosts of angels,

23.web: to the general assembly and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
23.asv: to the general assembly and church of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

24.web: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
24.asv: and to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better than that of Abel.

25.web: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
25.asv: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not when they refused him that warned them on earth, much more shall not we escape who turn away from him that warneth from heaven:

26.web: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
26.asv: whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more will I make to tremble not the earth only, but also the heaven.

27.web: This phrase, “Yet once more”, signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
27.asv: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

28.web: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let us have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
28.asv: Wherefore, receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us have grace, whereby we may offer service well-pleasing to God with reverence and awe:

29.web: for our God is a consuming fire.
29.asv: for our God is a consuming fire.
